item.description: The code attempts to decode bytes to string without checking if the data is actually bytes. This leads to AttributeError when bytes are passed to functions expecting dict-like objects.
item.contract: Ensure that bytes objects are properly decoded to strings before processing in the _assign method of the External class. The decoding should be done safely with proper error handling.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_encoding.py that were failing with AttributeError: 'bytes' object has no attribute 'items' should pass.

item.description: The _lookup_path method raises KeyError when a UUID is not found in the cache. This happens when test directories are not properly configured or when UUIDs are missing from the cache.
item.contract: Handle missing UUIDs gracefully in _lookup_path by generating a new UUID or falling back to a proper error handling mechanism instead of raising KeyError.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/external/storage/test_uuid.py that were failing with KeyError: 'uuid' should pass.

item.description: Black formatting error handling catches AssertionError but doesn't distinguish between different types of formatting errors, causing test failures in formatting tests.
item.contract: Improve error handling in format_code function to properly handle various formatting exceptions and provide clearer error messages without breaking tests.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_formatting.py that were failing with AssertionError should pass.

item.description: Missing logic for handling cases where external objects don't have stems in their location. This affects the flow when creating new external snapshots with UUID storage.
item.contract: Add proper handling for external objects that don't have stems in their location, ensuring consistent behavior when creating new external snapshots.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/external/storage/test_uuid.py that were failing due to missing stem handling should pass.

item.description: The _get_path method has insufficient validation for location parameters, particularly when dealing with empty stems or malformed locations.
item.contract: Improve validation and error handling in _get_path to prevent assertion errors and ensure robust path generation for external files.
item.acceptance: Tests that rely on proper path resolution for external files should pass without assertion errors.
